cards.designTerms: The Pack channel should own one adopted pack behind one interface (adopt, current, fetch, changed); each pack source (a folder, the designer's drafts, the test packs) is an adapter at its seam, and the Design studio reaches the running engine's copy only by message through Answering. Today the pack service's interface leaks the disk: it checks a path against the frozen inventory, then serves live bytes, and the token service re-reads the file around it, so frozen and live state cross the seam. No locality.
cards.standaloneLine: In a standalone game: each device loads whatever pack copy its source holds; the tablet can adopt a newer pack on a mid-game reload; the game carries no stamp, and no player device shows one.
